notes.title: Dreadwyrm Heir Joins the Fight!
notes.notes:
Hello Maidens!

If you're reading this, chances are you're into fighting games that break the mold.  If you're looking for your next weird PVP game to force your friends to play with you, I've got your back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/b633068dcd10a1c6517105db83d5afbab3fe00fb.png[/img]

Our very own Dreadwyrm Heir is a guest character in a fighting game that just came out, Duelists of Eden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/d4fce2c3fc69db3f037dfab2f51bb26b07b5c47f.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664200/Duelists_of_Eden/

Featuring grid and card based battles!  You build a deck of spells, and use those to fight others online.  It has some great pixel art, and like all good fighting games, rollback netcode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/2f782a9db40c83c44f0b57cc582de4d43e77c2cd.png[/img]

Hope you'll check it out!

notes.title: June 2023 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Maidens,

Unless you've been following my development updates on my upcoming game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132850/Rabbit_and_Steel/]RABBIT & STEEL (wishlist it now, do it!)[/url], it's been a little while!

After some consultation with the [url=discord.gg/mns]Discord[/url], it has been decided to pull back some of the changes that Lich and Stormbeast got in last year's update.

In addition, some players expressed an interest in playing some older builds, so I have made some of those available as separate branches.  Please feel free to play what you'd like!  Keep in mind, you'll only see lobbies of players who are on the same branch as you.

Without further ado, the patch notes!

notes.title: Updates & updates!
notes.notes:
Hello Maidens!  

...Are you still maidens?  
A lot can change in... 15 months since the last post, gosh.

I've been busy myself with a plethora of different things, so I'll try to bring you up to speed.

First off, new patch notes for a new balance patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/4480d1f09d28162f650620eb44a353cd9dc4e086.png[/img]

.........

Uh, on second thought, the patch notes are pretty long.
Maybe I'll separate that out into a different post.

.........


A few months ago, a couple of the top Maiden & Spell players approached me about possibly updating the game with a few balance tweaks.  Over the course of years of playing, a few lopsided matchups and weird quirks about particular moves had been rubbing them the wrong way.

So, we did a pretty long, back and forth, feedback-driven beta.

I'd be lying if I said these were carefully considered developer-knows-best changes.  The truth is, these people have gotten so good at the game, and know it in-and-out so well, that I can no longer win against them.

So uh, I mostly did what was asked of me.  And read lots of Discord discussions.  And the results are patch 1.3.2.0!
If you'd like to thank these brave maidens or try your luck playing against them, you can always do so in the Discord!

[url=discord.gg/mns]THE DISCORD[/url]

Yes, there are still people playing Maiden & Spell in 2022!  It's lasted a lot longer than I honestly thought it would.
It's still a great, welcoming community, so feel free to hop in, no matter your skill level.

------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f71ab83921efebc62e60d849541953a1ec0f1c76.png[/img]

Next order of business, [b]some news about my next game![/b] (it's not actually called 'Rabbit Game')

If you're not in [url=discord.gg/mns]THE DISCORD[/url], you might be a bit out of the loop.

Maybe you only, very vaguely, remember a post saying that I was making a Strategy Roguelite game with rabbit girls...

Uh, I'm not anymore!

Well, I'm still making a Roguelite game with rabbit girls.  Just not the 'Strategy' part.

I... [i]completely scrapped the game I had been making[/i], and [b]started anew last November[/b].

Don't worry, you didn't miss anything.  The game wasn't very good; that's why I scrapped it.

But, I didn't [i]really[/i] start anew either; because my new Roguelite game is... very similar to Maiden & Spell, to be honest.  It's reusing a lot of the code, as well as many stylistic choices.  And that's made development go very smoothly since rebooting the project.

So smoothly, in fact, that... [b]I'm almost ready to announce it officially!  Expect something before the end of the year![/b]

Here's a sneak preview to whet the appetite...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/eeb6118707fdde411dc40005adcb78cb67f4e1ab.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/551213890031f764ea0aea26f2e2ff6f0ec0d30b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/94dc622f7b7fc48daee09d81d030cd9e0033ae5f.gif[/img]

Please look forward to it!

----------------

One final bit of news!

Maiden & Spell characters are making a guest appearance in NOISZ STARLIVHT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/80e76cf3c648d28ccab257e7888b3195a464b883.jpg[/img]
https://twitter.com/noiszgame/status/1565544879958245376

You will be able to fight against the Heroes United to the tune of "The Stars Turned Reverse".

NOISZ STARLIVHT is available on both Android and iOS, so if you guys have phones (you guys have phones, right?), be sure to check it out!


See you all again very soon!

notes.title: Balance In All Things
notes.notes:
Hello maidens!  It's almost halfway through the year now.  I hope that news doesn't bring you dread!

If you're the kind of person who would click into this announcement, you might be aware that the [url=discord.gg/mns]Maiden & Spell Discord[/url] has been doing a bit of a balance thingamajig.

That has now ended; thanks everyone for your feedback!
I think we've gotten the game to a place where it's pretty okay.  There are still a few difficult matchups here and there, but characters got some desperately needed buffs and nerfs.

Also, thanks to a very generous member of the Discord (thank you Alec!), the game has been translated into Brazilian Portuguese.

First, patch notes!  Then some other things.

--------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/3c6ee826bc6be1c0232a123fdadf462b37acef8a.png[/img]

Wide Attack
-Number of bullets 22 > 20
-Attack lock 425ms > 550ms
-Takes an additional 75ms to gain a hitbox
-Added a visual effect to indicate direction of bullets


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/4744e148e5bceaf6e7d5264a5df7539319e87a6d.png[/img]

Basic Attack
-Unfocused bullet speed 12 > 10

Wide Attack
-Movespeed Mult x.85 > x.75
-Movespeed Mult duration 800ms > 1100ms
-Attacklock duration 700ms > 1000ms
-Time bullets are active 750ms > 650ms
-Range decreased

Stun Wave
-Stun time increased 1200ms > 1400ms


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1c24917faa143c1946add491a7f0d328933f1c71.png[/img]

Basic Attack
-Spell lock decreased by 300ms (previously went from 700ms > 400ms based on charge, now goes from 400ms > 100ms)
-Angle now decreases from 90 > 4 (was previously 90 > 10)
-Movespeed Mult while casting .3 > .5

Knife Throw
-Focused move color adjusted
-Focus knives now fan at an angle of 9 degrees between each shot (36 total)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/880b61dbfe64eaaf3a93218bd1d2281dedc31665.png[/img]

Basic Attack
-Hitbox linger time 600ms > 850ms
-Spawns 10% faster when focused

Wide Attack
-Attack lock reduced by 100ms (before it was 1000ms > 300ms based on charge, now it is 900ms > 200ms)
-Spell lock reduced by 100ms (same as attack lock)
-Time until hitbox is active is now a flat 500ms (up from 400ms-500ms based on charge)

Offensive Special
-Number of bullets on tap 24 > 28
-Attack lock reduced by 100ms (before it was 1000ms > 300ms based on charge, now it is 900ms > 200ms)
-Spell lock reduced by 100ms (same as attack lock)
-Cooldown reduced 5s > 4.5s
-Movespeed mult on tap increased 1.2x > 1.3x


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f6e1ac31b80eb05978e061e06e3a28a1c6b2487d.png[/img]

Wide Attack
-Spawn delay increases 600ms > 700ms > 800ms with combo (was previously a flat 600ms)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/09cdf89994d219029ebc034cc5c6a0cc17e4f099.png[/img]

Basic Attack
-Speed increased from 3.5 > 3.75
-Rate at which size increases matches speed increase


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1e5929847d88e3f0e63111606b42dbda2e17dd90.png[/img]

Time Stop
-Cast time reduced 550ms > 475ms


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f16b39104bd731719b134ee70776d303bc815838.png[/img]

Basic Attack
-Bullet speed at maximum charge decreased 6.5 > 4.5

Wide Attack
-Order in which bullets appear has been reversed (shallower angle appears first now)

--------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1ded5b81f00be8537f2cab20dd19b3fa0e9e5d96.png[/img]
Now that's out of the way...

How have you all been spending your year so far?
I've been working hard on my next game.


...Uh, I know that I said I would be doing extra character costumes for Maiden & Spell in the past but, unfortunately, I'm not sure that's happening anymore.  Maybe in the sequel (my next game is not a Maiden & Spell sequel).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/04cb41ba4b784638968cbf2f9f8b4356e452df04.png[/img]

If I'm being honest, I've not done a great job of managing my time and priorities this past year.  It's caused me to fall behind on a lot of things, the care and maintenance of Maiden & Spell just being one of them.

It's been over a year since I launched Maiden & Spell, and after a number of game prototypes that I threw out, a personal break that went on a bit longer than it should have, and some Switch port troubles, I have only just semi-recently cobbled together a solid direction and plan for the next game.

It's a roguelike!  Featuring cute girls.  Cute [i]rabbit-y[/i] girls.  Also the gameplay is pretty unique, if I do say so myself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/050821c4ac38665d3894f2efa6ed09e11338e8f4.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/3e0608ea5fc4f6d6b8443898c21567d44d21d4c6.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/2fef2e65cb2eb4481f9eb3df9a4e44fb4e70cec6.gif[/img]

I'm not [i]quite[/i] ready to show the game to the world.  I'll put out an official announcement a bit closer to when it's actually ready to play this time around.  Maybe around 6-8 months out from launch or so!

If I've at all piqued your interest, consider joining either [url=https://mailchi.mp/2516536f5292/mino_dev]my mailing list[/url] or the [url=discord.gg/mns]Maiden & Spell Discord[/url].  You'll get a notification one way or another (and maybe a sneak preview or two...?).  And the Maiden & Spell Discord is still the best place to find a great community and battle people online!  In case you need something to pass the time.

Hope to see you again soon!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]Maiden & Spell is 30% off during the Steam Summer Sale![/b]
If you're reading this you probably already have the game... [i][b]but do all of your friends!?[/b][/i]

Just think!  Social interaction is precious in these dark times.  For the low price of just under 10USD, you could make your best buddy feel obligated to play some online matches with you!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.0: End of Beta + Korean Localization!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After about 2 and a half weeks, the balance-beta is over!
We made a LOT of changes and adjustments.  Many of the characters got new movement options, buffed moves, opportunities for counterplay in certain matchups, and more.

If you've been playing with friends on the main branch, you might be surprised at the new tools your favorite character has.  Be sure to check them out when you get the chance!

But first: the game also now has an [i]official Korean translation[/i], thanks to one [b]A1NVERSE[/b]!  He's been a member of the M&S community from the beginning, and was kind enough to make an official translation for the game.


Without further ado, here's all the changes that came out of the Beta!
There's so many, you might just have to try the game out yourself to get the full experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/4480d1f09d28162f650620eb44a353cd9dc4e086.png[/img]

- Added a Korean Translation for the game.
- Fixed issue where "ghosts" would be left behind in lobbies.
- Fixed issue where P2 getting hit would sometimes desync match spectators.
- Fixed issue where the Training menu could crash
- Fixed issue where the Training menu option text would bleed over the screen in Japanese
- Fixed issue where bullets would sometimes not be properly erased over netplay
- Fixed issue where the lobby chat would make the framerate dip when people typed in Asian languages
- Fixed issue where the framerate would drop in certain stages if not playing the game in English
- Fixed issue where Stormbeast's Doppelganger would aim the wrong way in netplay
- Fixed various typos


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1e5929847d88e3f0e63111606b42dbda2e17dd90.png[/img]

Dimi Dark
- Bullet speed increased 1.1x

Lat Dark
- Attack length 240 > 260
- Movement speed while firing .65x > .6x
- Visual effect adjusted

Time Stop
- Now applies .7x movespeedmult to enemies within clock

Arcane Magic
- "Slow" status affect adjusted
    - Movement speed multiplier x0.7 > x0.8
    - Attack interval multiplier x1.4 > x1.2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f16b39104bd731719b134ee70776d303bc815838.png[/img]

Bolt Strike
- Uncharged shot now fires a faster bullet (speed 28px) when focused, with a spawn delay of 700ms
- Will no longer be erased by Novi Life while charging
- Uncharged movespeedmult .35x > .4x
- Uncharged spawn time 500ms > 400ms

notes.title: Beta Balancing Branch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  I hope you've all been staying safe.

As it'll likely be a little while before I do more serious content updates, I wanted to try to get the game's balance in a better place for those that are playing online on a regular basis.

After reading a lot of feedback on the Discord, I thought that the best move going forward would be to temporarily open a beta branch so we can try a lot of different changes to characters.

Since I don't want to split the playerbase between the "proper" game and a rapidly changing beta for too long, my goal is to only have the beta open for a few weeks at most.  Hopefully I can make some progress towards having a well balanced game in that time.

To access the beta branch:

[olist]
[*]Right click the game in your Steam library
[*]Click "Properties"
[*]Go to the 'Betas' tab
[*]Select 'Beta' from the drop down menu
[/olist]

[b]Again, while the beta is running, many of the game's regulars might be on the beta branch, and thus their lobbies won't be visible on the main branch.  If you're having trouble finding a match online, the place to look for opponents is in the Discord![/b]

https://discord.gg/mns

Also, since the Beta branch will likely be in constant flux, I won't post the patch notes here (as they'll likely just be out of date all the time).  I'll keep accurate patch notes in the Discord, and post the finalized patch notes once all the changes are done.

Hope to see you online!

notes.title: 1.0.2.0 Update, and Future Content Plans!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  I present to you... a minor bug-fixing update!

Well, there are a few new things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/baacd0daec718063412fe2e218a75a48cd8c840f.png[/img]

Selectable skill levels!  Feel free to warn people of what they're about to get into by taking you on.  Or to convey how terrible you are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/b10bf2ceacd7ca7c59e43ec858bed514cb4882f0.png[/img]

With that out of the way, let's talk future content!

My original plan with Maiden & Spell was to gradually introduce new costumes and characters over time.  You might have seen a little bit of a preview of this; if you've checked out the Art Gallery or been hanging around [url=https://discord.gg/mns]the game's Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/d49e38f45d3bef557976b06b1fcabf091490a09e.gif[/img]

Like this one!  Look at how cute it is!!

Buuuuuut, as you might have heard, there are going to be quite a few exciting games coming out over the coming months!  And if the plan is to bring new attention to the game, maybe small updates over time aren't the way to go.

So, change of plans!  Instead of making tiny updates every few weeks or so, [b]I'm going to put everything I want to add in the game into one big update, and release it a few months from now.  That will likely happen late summer/early fall.[/b]

Costumes, DLC characters... who knows what the future holds?  We might even... [b]switch[/b] things up a bit.

I'll let you all know a little in advance what's coming, so stay tuned for that.  Stay safe until then!

There are still a few pesky bugs I'd like to fix in a minor update, most notably the crash that occasionally happens when you exit a netplay lobby.  I believe that this is happening because of a flaw in the Gamemaker Steam Lobby API, which means it's difficult for me to nail down the cause.  If you see any random updates that don't do anything, it's probably my attempts to fix this!  [b]If you have any info on the conditions for this crash happening, please contact me and let me know.[/b]


One more thing before you go!  If you're reading this the day it's posted, then Bandcamp is giving 100% of revenue to artists today!  It's a perfect time to pick up the bonus OST tracks from Hagane's Bandcamp if you haven't already:

https://steelplus.bandcamp.com/album/maiden-spell-original-soundtrack

See you all again in the future!


[b]Full patch notes:[/b]

-Added an adjustable "skill level" to player profiles
-Added additional bullet transparency option to the Battle Options
-Added Turkish and Romanian flags
-Added separate keybind for chatting in the lobby
-Alt-tabbing out of the game will now mute game music, except for in the Music Room.  You can disable this functionality in the Sound Options

-Chat log now stores messages for longer; additional messages can be seen by opening a text window
-Chat log now includes messages when someone:
[list]
[*] Joins a lobby
[*] Leaves a lobby
[*] Challenges someone
[*] Spectates a match
[/list]

-Adjusted visibility of Silent Redhood's kunai
-Adjusted visibility of Stormbeast's clone
-Added a visual effect to Royal Arcanist's basic attack

-Fixed issue where Filipino flag was upside-down
-Fixed issue where game would occasionally crash when the host disbanded a lobby
-Fixed issue where Stormbeast's Flashstep would have a full cooldown timer when interrupted
-Fixed issue where being stunned or Time Stopped would prevent certain actions from happening, such as Butterflies firing or Paralyze activating
-Fixed issue where you could move your character with the control stick in Training Mode or online lobbies even if you had a menu open
-Fixed issue where "ghosts" of other players or challenges would linger for people in a lobby
-Fixed issue where, during online matches, bullets would be erased on one player's screen but not the other
-Increased the time that spectators have to connect to matches, to prevent disconnections

notes.title: Character Balance Patch + Training Mode Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Maidens and others!

Ever since the game launched I've gotten a lot of feedback, replays and discussion of the character balance right now.  In addition, I've gotten the chance to fight a lot of different people online!

I had predicted that there would be [i]at least one[/i] unwinnable match-up or broken move at launch... yeah, there were a few.

So the patch to fix some of those imbalances is coming tomorrow.  The game's testers and I have been working hard on this, and hope that it makes the game a little more playable.

Here are the preliminary balance patch notes!  Times are in milliseconds, distances are in pixels at 1080p resolution, speeds are in pixels per frame at 60fps, and angles are in degrees, unless otherwise stated.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1e5929847d88e3f0e63111606b42dbda2e17dd90.png[/img]

Lat Dark
- Bullet spawn radius 75px > 140px
- Combo length 250ms > 1000ms (the time until you do the first part of the spiral rather than the second)
- Movement speed while firing .55x > .65x
- Attack length 280ms > 240ms
- Bullet speed 7.5px > 9px

Novi Starfall
- Bullet scale .9x > 1x

Arcane Magic
- Adjusted delay to be slightly less dependant on distance



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f6e1ac31b80eb05978e061e06e3a28a1c6b2487d.png[/img]

Unfocused movement speed 8px > 8.75px

Dimi Life
- Bullet spread 10° > 12°

Lat Wide
- Distance between rings 250px > 220px

Butterfly Thrall
- Bullet spread 10° > 12°
- MoveSpeedMult .7x > .8x

Novi Life
- Increased number of times it erases non-invincible bullets



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/4744e148e5bceaf6e7d5264a5df7539319e87a6d.png[/img]

Swordplay
- Direction lock .3x > .4x

Swordstorm
- Direction lock .3x > .15x

Dodge Roll
- Invincibility Time 550ms > 350ms
- Move speed boost
	- Duration 100ms > 200ms
	- Speed 1.7x > 2x
- Attack Lock 0ms > 300ms
- Direction Lock Length 200ms > 350ms
- Now slows your movement by .4x for 400ms after execution (Can be canceled by using a different attack)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/f16b39104bd731719b134ee70776d303bc815838.png[/img]

Bolt Strike
- Can now be charged for longer and grow larger

Discharge
- Fire delay 0ms > 160ms
- Bullet spawn radius 0px > 150px
- Effect added
- Fire time is now the same on doppel and player, instead of being delayed



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1c24917faa143c1946add491a7f0d328933f1c71.png[/img]

Unfocused movement speed 11px > 12.5px

Sniper shot
- Arrow maximum speed 25px > 22px
- Minimum angle 15° > 12°
- Fixed arrows 'appearing' faster than bullets locally
- Fixed bug where arrows would not rollback properly

Bind
- Shape of bullets has changed to be tighter, number of bullets increased
- Magnus Damage 15/tic > 10/tic

Knife Juggle
- Now cancels MoveLock and MoveSpeedMult
- Speed of knives increased 12px > 14px

Vanish
- Speed during invisible 1.3x > 1.6x
- Speed reduction on appear .2x > .4x



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/09cdf89994d219029ebc034cc5c6a0cc17e4f099.png[/img]

Lat Water
- Bullet speed reduced 6px > 5px and 4px > 3.5px

Saphire Flare
- Maximum combo decreased 7 > 4
- Angle now becomes shallower as button is held 
    -Total angle goes from 60° > 30°
- Distance increase with each combo increased
- Direction Lock .1x > 0x
- Direction Lock can no longer be canceled with focus
- MoveSpeedMult .2x > .15x



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/880b61dbfe64eaaf3a93218bd1d2281dedc31665.png[/img]

Lat Holy
- Bullet sprite adjusted so that the time it doesn't have a hitbox is more apparent
- Time for the attack to have a hitbox 400ms > 500ms


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/543c95c0663630303372ebb65e7f84394cfaf675.png[/img]

- The cooldown time when a cast is interrupted is now half the normal cooldown, instead of the full cooldown.


----------------------------------------------------


You'll also be able to see these values for yourself in the updated Training Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34270977/1f51b53e2539a185fa109e209276c3d205cbf699.gif[/img]

These are some of the numbers working behind the scene to make the moves what they are.  It's kind of like a character's frame data!

You can see there's 9 little timers counting down when you do moves.  They determine things like how fast you can move while attacking, or when you're able to attack again.

They are, left to right top to bottom:

-Move speed mult: Your character moves more slowly while this timer counts down.
-Move lock: Your character is unable to move.
-Direction lock: Your arrow tracks the opponent more slowly.
-Attack lock: Your character is unable to use most Basic/Wide attacks.
-Spell lock: Your character is unable to use most Offensive/Defensive Specials.
-Action lock: Your character cannot use any other attacks.
-Invincibility: Your character is impervious to damage.
-Cooldown Hold: After this timer counts down, a move that's waiting to go on cooldown (Like Dreadwyrm's Garnet Flare) will go on cooldown.
-Combo: Combo moves will do the next move in the combo, rather than starting from the first move.

Hopefully that's not too confusing!  There's lots of numbers on the backend.

The patch will hopefully drop [b]Wednesday at around noon.[/b]  I'm still doing some last minute bug fixing, so depending on that it might be a little bit earlier or later!

Please look forward to it!

NETPLAY TROUBLESHOOTING FAQ:

[b]Q: I am trying to connect to a lobby, but it won't connect.  What's wrong?[/b]
A: The person you are trying to connect to likely hasn't opened their ports.  If they are a friend of yours, tell them to consult the this post on how to do so:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=459573674

[b]Q: I'm challenging someone to a match, but then it says "no response from opponent" and kicks us back to the lobby.[/b]
A: Again, someone hasn't opened their ports.  Open your ports!  UDP and TCP both!

[b]Q: I have found a bug.  Where do I report it?[/b]
A: Thanks!  Bug reports are welcomed and encouraged.
Feel free to reply to this post with your bug report, or post it in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/mns

[b]Q: How long is the Beta going to last?[/b]
A: The Beta is currently planned to last until Tuesday the 11th at noon EST.  After that, I'll be turning off the lobby list server until the game proper comes out.

[b]Q: Me/my friend started a private lobby, but I/they can't find it in the listing.[/b]
A: Private lobbies are only view-able when you search for them.  Search for your friend's name (not case-sensitive), it should appear.

[b]Q: I have a question or comment about something else.[/b]
A: If you need an immediate response, try the Discord!
https://discord.gg/mns


Again, I'd like to apologize for not getting the Steam API totally set up before this, as port-forwarding can be a bit confusing to do.  Hopefully all of that will be sorted out for the release on the 25th!
Hope you get some good games in!

notes.title: It's November!
notes.notes:
Hey all!  You might have noticed that the date of the game's release has changed from "2019" to "2020" up in the corner there.
Does this mean the game is getting delayed a year?  Nope!  In fact, I hope to release it very early next year, probably by February or so.
For those who aren't following the game too closely, I thought I'd just give a quick update on development progress, and the planned schedule from here.

Current progress:
[list]
[*]All characters and stages that the game will be launching with are done and ready
[*]All the planned extras for the game are complete
[*]Versus Mode, Training Mode, etc.. are feature complete
[*]The music for the game is almost all done, with just a few more adjustments left
[*]Story Mode is *mostly* done, there are a few tasks left to put it all together
[*]Netplay: the part where you actually fight someone peer to peer is complete (and buttery smooth, if I do say so myself)
[*]...But the lobby system where you can connect and challenge people still needs some work.
[/list]

My plans for the coming months are: finish the netplay experience, finish the whole Story Mode, then release the game!


I also plan to release an updated version of the GameJolt demo before the end of the month.  It won't have any new characters or content, but it will have updated UI, access to "Silly Settings" in Versus Mode, and a Chinese translation.  And, it will be here on Steam!

I would also like to do *some* kind of beta for the netplay once it's complete.... but haven't decided exactly what kind yet.  I'm somewhat between two options:

Option 1) Begin preorders for the game, and have a closed beta with all of the characters.
Option 2) Add netplay to the free demo, and have an open beta with the 4 included characters.

If you have any opinions, I'm all ears!  Feel free to join the Discord and let me know, or just leave a comment on this post.
